refs.description: What the resources of the sibling releases are, by release id, kind and resource id: the name, the namespace, the labels of the pods and the name of the Secret. Set by the parent chart (refsIndex mutation), for the references (`ref:<id>`) to resources of a sibling release.

checkRequiredValues.description: Whether to check and fail if some values are null. Defaults to true.

prefixNamesWithRelease.description: Whether the name of the resources is prefixed with the release name (<release>-<id>). When false, the name is the id (or nameOverride). Defaults to false.

labels.description: metadata.labels applied to every resource of every kind.

annotations.description: metadata.annotations applied to every resource of every kind.

namespace.description: metadata.namespace fallback for every resource of every kind, used when the resource doesn't set its own namespace. Defaults to the release namespace.
